title: Import bundle v1: public_access.json
description: What people without a membership could read in the source, already in Specivo's terms.

anonymous_allowed.description: Whether the source served visitors without an account at all.

anonymous_source_setting.description: The source setting that decided it, for the report.

anonymous_permissions.description: Project ref to what a visitor could read there.

non_member_source_name.description: The source's name for its signed-in non-member role.

non_member_permissions.description: What that role grants on a public project, in Specivo's permission names.

not_carried_over.description: Source permissions with no place in Specivo, one line each.
